name: S3xS3.bracket_apply_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracket_apply_inl (x y : LieVec) (i : I3) :
    bracket x y (Sum.inl i) =
      ((fun j ↦ x (Sum.inl j)) ⨯₃ (fun j ↦ y (Sum.inl j))) i

@[simp]
theorem bracket_apply_inr (x y : LieVec) (i : I3) :

name: S3xS3.Naturality.bracket_add_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_add_left (x x' y : LieVec) :
    bracket (x + x') y = bracket x y + bracket x' y

name: S3xS3.Naturality.bracket_add_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_add_right (x y y' : LieVec) :
    bracket x (y + y') = bracket x y + bracket x y'

name: S3xS3.Naturality.bracket_smul_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_smul_left (c : ℝ) (x y : LieVec) :
    bracket (c • x) y = c • bracket x y

name: S3xS3.Naturality.bracket_smul_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_smul_right (c : ℝ) (x y : LieVec) :
    bracket x (c • y) = c • bracket x y

name: S3xS3.Naturality.curvatureVec_add_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma curvatureVec_add_left (g : LeftInvariantMetric)
    (x x' y z : LieVec) :
    curvatureVec g (x + x') y z =

name: S3xS3.Naturality.curvatureVec_add_middle

name: S3xS3.Naturality.curvatureVec_smul_middle

name: S3xS3.Naturality.curvatureVec_smul_right

name: S3xS3.Naturality.koszulForm_smul_left

name: S3xS3.Trivial.positive_radial_factors
statement:
lemma positive_radial_factors {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hprod : 0 < (y - x) * (2 * x - y)) : x < y ∧ y < 2 * x

name: S3xS3.Trivial.radial_alpha_strict
statement:
lemma radial_alpha_strict {ell x y c alpha : ℝ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hcidentity : 3 * c = 2 * x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + ell)
    (hcauchy : c ≤ x * y) (halpha : alpha = x ^ 2 - c) :
    alpha < -ell

name: S3xS3.Trivial.theta_large_iff
S3xS3.Trivial.theta_small_iff
statement:
lemma theta_small_iff {S theta : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (htheta : theta ≠ 0) :
    S * (theta - 1) / theta < 0 ↔ 0 < theta ∧ theta < 1

name: S3xS3.Trivial.threshold_four_large_middle
statement:
lemma threshold_four_large_middle {r s t : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    0 < r * s - 2 * r - 2 * s + 2 * t
